title: The Thorn of the Weeping Wood
author: Quentin Kavanagh
blurb: Ansel Voss, a cartographer of unmapped realms, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
